description: This file defines an enum 'EventKitAuthorization' with static functions to determine read and write access permissions based on 'EKAuthorizationStatus' values, for handling EventKit authorization.

methods.name: allowsRead
methods.description: Determines if read access is authorized based on the provided 'EKAuthorizationStatus'.

methods.name: allowsWrite
methods.description: Determines if write access is authorized based on the provided 'EKAuthorizationStatus'.
